# AL BAHR HORIZON TRAVELS AND CONSULTANTS — Lahore, Pakistan

> AL BAHR HORIZON TRAVELS AND CONSULTANTS is a premium travel and visa consultancy based in Lahore, Pakistan, serving Pakistani travellers since 2015. Services: Umrah & Hajj packages, global visit visas, international ticketing, GAMCA/Wafid medical appointments, jobs abroad, and study abroad (Germany, Italy, China, Hungary, South Korea, Turkey).
